_doc: Required-infrastructure exceptions (ruling 2026-10-14, D&B Dilemma). A target that ordinary businesses cannot realistically avoid keeps every finding, but its Action Meter is capped at `score` with these `instructions`. `match` lists names that identify the entity (whole words, case-insensitive). `domains` are the entity's own domains: if the scanned target points anywhere else (besides an app store), it may be an impersonator and the exception does not apply. Add an entry here to add an exception: no code change. See functions/requiredInfrastructure.js.

entries.instructions: Professional consideration. Dun & Bradstreet is required business infrastructure: D-U-N-S numbers and D&B records are used in business verification, credit, and contracting, and some platforms require one. Every finding in this report stands in full, including the FTC's 2022 order and the 2025 $5.7 million settlement. Deal with it professionally: read renewal terms and sales claims carefully and keep records.
